article_full_10000.admission_gate_execution_policy: record every failed scientific gate and continue without refitting
article_full_10000.purpose: Attempt exactly 10000 LHS candidates in independent 8000-row development and 2000-row descriptive holdout streams. Audit rejected mechanistic attempts and retain the accepted subsets without replacement.

design.method: each development and holdout block is one fixed strength-1 Latin hypercube
design.final_accepted_design_description: accepted rows are the numerically valid subset of each fixed Latin hypercube; rejected candidates are not replaced
design.optimization_start_seed_status: retired legacy multistart seed; the production start is the deterministic componentwise box center

mechanistic_generation.stability_step_agreement_note: Revised from 1e-9 after the complete 500-row preflight showed that all 21 apparent failures passed every physical, convergence, branch, and stability-margin gate and differed only in the prescribed two-step finite-difference eigenvalue estimate (maximum observed discrepancy 9.281e-7 d^-1); see manuscript revision record.
mechanistic_generation.candidate_acceptance_branch_rule: exact equality of the complete two-start nonsmooth branch-classification tuple; no development-calibrated branch-margin generation screen

candidate_policy.ordinary_rejection_action: retain the failed attempt, exclude it from analysis, and do not replace it

surrogate.selection: largest ridge within one descriptive standard error of minimum raw complete reduced-response nRMSE
surrogate.solver: column-pivoted QR on augmented ridge system

overflow_tss_closure.purpose: represent the positive nonlinear Clarifier-overflow TSS dependence that the system response regression does not reliably preserve at low concentrations
overflow_tss_closure.inputs_and_basis: the same seven controls, twenty influent components, and standardized complete second-order basis used by the Extended ICSOR response regression
overflow_tss_closure.selection: largest ridge within one descriptive standard error of minimum out-of-fold log-scale RMSE
overflow_tss_closure.projection_use: enforce the predicted positive overflow TSS as one system-wide linear equality after multiplication by effluent flow

projection.outlet_tss_coordinates: derived from Clarifier outlet component-flow vectors and their positive flow factors
projection.overflow_tss_closure_equality: t_X^T g_E = q_E X_ref exp(g_log(theta, c_N))
projection.overflow_tss_closure_calibration: out-of-fold predictions for development projection scales and trust calibration; final frozen closure for post-selection holdout and optimization
projection.clarifier_inventory_bounds: tight endpoint-envelope bounds implemented as two division-free linear rows
projection.independent_multiplier_reconstruction: bounded-variable least squares active-set method (BVLS); a deterministic BVLS representation is reported when multipliers are nonunique, without a minimum-multiplier-norm claim
projection.multiplier_reconstruction_revision_reaso: TRF premature termination produced a false stationarity rejection despite an accepted primal OSQP solution; BVLS resolves the fixed finite bounded least-squares problem directly

trust.clarifier_flux_retirement_reason: no scalar function of outlet flows and aggregate Clarifier inventory reproduces the discarded layer-flux equations
trust.clarifier_layer_flux_audit_scope: smooth-direct and exact mechanistic states only

hard_failures: non-finite or incomplete arrays required downstream
undefined feature, response, or physical scale
rank or factorization failure that prevents construction of the declared problem
contract, hash, provenance, or checkpoint inconsistency

optimization.start_definition: componentwise center of the normalized seven-control box
optimization.surrogate_primary_solver: seven-variable constrained local optimization with exact cold projection-QP evaluation and active-set KKT sensitivities
optimization.surrogate_outer_method: SLSQP with analytical total derivatives through the active lower-QP KKT system

surrogate_active_set_derivative_fallback.trigger: exact active-set derivative construction is unavailable
surrogate_active_set_derivative_fallback.projection_qp_at_each_distinct_trial: new cold solve and independent audit of the same exact projection QP, including the frozen log-overflow-TSS closure equality
surrogate_active_set_derivative_fallback.cache_scope: exactly identical normalized control vectors only
surrogate_active_set_derivative_fallback.selection: smallest-objective validated feasible visited point, with the declared relative objective and lexicographic tie rules
surrogate_active_set_derivative_fallback.local_optimum_label_requires: COBYQA convergence and a passing independent endpoint active-set/upper-KKT audit
surrogate_active_set_derivative_fallback.budget_limited_or_failed_kkt_label: best feasible visited incumbent; stationarity unresolved

surrogate_local_convergence_certificatio.fine_directions: signed coordinate basis, all signed pairwise coordinate diagonals, and the eight vertices of a seven-dimensional Helmert regular simplex (106 directions)
surrogate_local_convergence_certificatio.feasible_direction_rank_policy: reported as a diagnostic only because the feasible cone at an active constrained endpoint need not span all seven dimensions
surrogate_local_convergence_certificatio.search_acceleration: after a winning poll step, test the same coupled feasible ray at deterministic geometric multipliers before repeating the full poll; acceleration trials never count as convergence evidence
surrogate_local_convergence_certificatio.strong_certificate: independent lower active-set and upper KKT audit
surrogate_local_convergence_certificatio.degenerate_certificate: complete finite-resolution feasible no-descent poll at both radii
surrogate_local_convergence_certificatio.failure_action: retain the best feasible incumbent, label certification unresolved, and continue

optimization.surrogate_stage_warm_start: not applicable; the embedded-KKT IPOPT continuation is retired
optimization.upper_constraint_normalization: fixed positive precomputed scale for every row; never iterate-dependent
optimization.surrogate_final_refinement: retired as a post-continuation refinement; exact cold projection QP with active-set sensitivities is now the primary surrogate optimizer
optimization.surrogate_failure_action: record the case failure and continue with the remaining cases and downstream audits

direct_failure_recovery.start: the independently projected surrogate endpoint for the same case
direct_failure_recovery.failure_action: record an unpaired direct failure and continue

optimization.maximum_iterations_per_stage_scope: direct smooth-mechanistic continuation only; no surrogate IPOPT stages are executed

reporting.timing_source: primary route search duration from robustness_01 through robustness_10
reporting.timing_aggregation: arithmetic mean across available robustness-case Time records, with count, total, median, interquartile range, nearest-rank 95th percentile, and maximum also reported
reporting.common_reference_scope: every available selected decision in the nominal and ten robustness cases
reporting.common_reference_acceptance: both exact starts accepted, agreement under generation and fixed state scales, categorical branch agreement unless any mismatching branch is within the declared ambiguity band, physical/stability acceptance, and engineering feasibility
reporting.branch_boundary_policy: record as a qualifier; accept when exact physical checks and required replay agreement pass
reporting.holdout_interpretation: descriptive post-selection evidence only; excluded from fitting, scaling, ridge selection, trust calibration, and scientific eligibility gates
